en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a hand-colored photograph of a broad river ('Indalsälfven') and a distinctive bridge crossing it, with rolling, forested hills and rural Scandinavian scenery. The postcard is inscribed with 'Indalsälfven i Indal' in red text in the upper left of the image. The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text, an address, an old 'SVERIGE' (Sweden) postage stamp, and 'BREFKORT – UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE – CARTE POSTALE'.
